changelog:
v2.12.2 - Security Scanner Accuracy Fix

- No more false 'sideloaded' flags on pre-installed / system / licensed firmware apps (their installer legitimately reads as 'unknown').
- Only USER-installed apps from outside Play Store / Galaxy Store are marked sideloaded.
- Quick permission scan now shows ONLY your installed apps (system apps excluded) + shows where each app came from.
- New honest info line: user apps from unknown sources (your own Termux/Shizuku/Empire installs).
